IncidentBot: PagerDuty triggered for acme-prod-dedicated-1 — p95 latency 1350ms, error rate 2.1% over 5m. Alert key: reserved-pool-throttle. PD Incident: INC-8921. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8921

Ingrid (oncall): ack. I'm on it, pulling traces and checking which replica is failing.

Sam: ack. I'll pull infra metrics and logs, checking autoscale events.

Riley: I see spillback activity — requests are being rerouted off the dedicated pool and queuing. Likely backpressure from KV cache churn.

Jane - AcmeCorp CS: Customers report timeouts and slow responses in app. Any ETA on mitigation?

Ingrid (oncall): quick findings: router logs show repeated 503 -> backend busy. Grafana p95 shot up, CPU on several dedicated nodes at ~98%.

Sam: running quick grep: `kubectl -n dedicated logs -l tenant=acme --since=12m | grep -E "backpressure|KV_CACHE_EVICT|ALLOC_FAIL"` — multiple KV_CACHE_EVICT lines, memory pressure spikes.

Riley: Proposed short-term actions: 1) enable controlled spillback to hosted pool with strict rate limits, 2) scale reserved pool by +2 GPUs if allowed, 3) notify customer. Who can flip the route?

Sam: I can perform the route change. Running the runbook command now:
```
redwood route update --tenant acme --add-fallback hosted:acme-hosted-spill --rate 200
```

Sam: applying...

IncidentBot: Route change applied by Sam at 2765432112. Fallback policy active: hosted:acme-hosted-spill, rate=200rps.

PagerDuty: INC-8921 acknowledged by Ingrid (oncall).

Ingrid (oncall): confirming downstream behavior after spillback. Monitoring p95 and error rate.

Riley: after the spillback flip p95 dropped to ~420ms and error rate down to ~0.3%, so user impact reduced but tail still high. We need to address KV cache churn to prevent recurrence.

Sam: issuing scale request: `infra scale reserved acme-prod +2` — command executed, nodes provisioning, ETA ~3m.

Jane - AcmeCorp CS: thanks — please keep me posted if we need to shift traffic or if there will be any customer-visible changes beyond improved latency.

Ingrid (oncall): expected recovery timeline: if scale completes and eviction rate subsides, we should be stable within ~10 minutes. Continuing to watch.

Riley: creating follow-up ticket for eng-runtime and eng-ml: probable root cause is a batch-size/quantization change that increased KV cache miss rate after last model push. Tagging with logs and sample traces.

Sam: handing off monitoring to Riley for the night shift in 15m. Adding runbook notes and command history to the PD incident.

Riley: I have the handoff. Will keep an eye and escalate if spillback usage creeps above threshold or if error rate climbs. Adding this to oncall rotation notes.

IncidentBot: INC-8921 auto-clear at 2765432130 — status transitioned from degraded -> ok. Notes: spillback enabled; reserved pool scaled +2; follow-up ticket created.

Ingrid (oncall): closing thread for now. We'll run a blameless postmortem tomorrow and confirm root cause & remediation (hotfix or rollback). Thanks all. :folded_hands:

Jane - AcmeCorp CS: Appreciate the quick response — thanks everyone :heart:
